title: Pin state observation
description: One pin of one configuration's recursive tree, with its state on each host that holds a copy of the child. Emitted by the pin walker (one JSON object per line) and stored as an observation of kind pin_state. A pin is identified by (parent repo, parent commit, path): rc4 has 44. Owner: pin walker. A3, B2, B3, B7, B9.

observed_at.description: A3: the OLDEST observed_at inside `fact`, so the envelope never looks fresher than its data.

url.description: B9: the URL exactly as .gitmodules at the parent commit writes it.

url_kind.description: B3: `ssh` is the SSH-only state (no anonymous fetch through this URL); `local` is the local-path state.

branch_field.description: B3: .gitmodules branch= as written. Recorded for display, never used to compute anything.

entry_type.description: What the parent's tree holds at `path`. Anything but `commit` gives state NO_GITLINK; the walker never drops the entry.

catalogued_as.description: B9: `unknown` = the URL matches no component, copy, alias or external entry, which raises an alert.

repo.description: The repo the URL names, after alias normalisation. null for local/other URLs.

tree_paths.description: B2: path(s) from the configuration's root checkout, as `git submodule status --recursive` prints them. More than one when the same parent commit appears twice in the tree.

depth.description: B2: 1 for a direct submodule of the configuration. rc4 reaches 5.

split.description: B7: the same child component is pinned at more than one commit in this tree.

effective.description: B7: whether the build uses this pin. `unknown` until CI captures the build's file lists.

hosts.description: B3: one entry per host that has a copy of the child (canonical, copies, aliases resolved). Empty for LOCAL_URL / NO_GITLINK pins.

role.description: Which catalogue repo this is for the child.

pinned.description: True for the host the pinned URL points at: the one a recursive clone uses.

lag.description: B3: commits on the default branch that the pin lacks. Integer for ON_DEFAULT and TAGGED-on-default, else null.

branches.description: Branches on this host that contain the commit (heads only; never PR/MR refs).

tags.description: Tags on this host that point at or contain the commit.
